name: Diagnosis Priority
citation: HL7 v2.8.2 Chapter 2C sec 2.C.2.284 (p155), User-defined Table 0359 - Diagnosis Priority; Chapter 6 sec 6.5.2.15 DG1-15 (p34): 'The value 1 means that this is the primary diagnosis. Values 2-99 convey ranked secondary diagnoses', so the printed 0, 1, 2 and ellipsis rows are not a closed set
